international.title: Communications watchdog leadership reversed findings of draft report into ABC Four Corners program, FoI documents reveal
international.summary: Documents show draft Acma reports backed reporting of Gold Walkley award-winning journalist Mark Willacy about Australian War Memorial Sign up for Guardian Australia’s free weekly media newsletter here An investigation by staff of the Australian Media and Communications Authority (Acma) cleared an ABC Four Corners program over its War Memorial reporting – only for the draft report findings to be reversed by the regulator’s leadership, freedom of information documents reveal. Internal correspondence shows the 11th hour backflip forced a “retrofit” of the report which initially said: “Staff are of the preliminary view that the program did not breach the impartiality provision of the [ABC] code [of conduct] with respect to this allegation.” Continue reading...
